## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
rm(list = ls())

library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
here()
demand <- read.csv("Data/Processed/CleanDemand_v1.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

temp <- read.csv("Data/Processed/CleanTemp_v1.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

humidity <- read.csv("Data/Processed/CleanHumidity_v1.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

data_full <- demand %>%
  left_join(temp, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(humidity, by = "date")

nobs <- nrow(data_full)
```

## Create Clean Time Series Objects

```{r}
# Handle NAs BEFORE creating msts
demand_clean <- na.interp(data_full$avg_load, linear = TRUE)
demand_msts <- msts(demand_clean,
                    seasonal.periods = c(7, 365.25),
                    start = c(2005, 1))

# Weather matrix
weather_xreg <- cbind(temp = data_full$avg_temp,
                      humid = data_full$avg_humidity)
```

## Training / Validation Split

```{r}
n_for <- 365

# Training data
train_load <- data_full$avg_load[1:(nobs - n_for)]
train_load_clean <- na.interp(train_load, linear = TRUE)
demand_train <- msts(train_load_clean,
                     seasonal.periods = c(7, 365.25),
                     start = c(2005, 1))

# Weather split
weather_train <- weather_xreg[1:(nobs - n_for), ]
weather_test <- weather_xreg[(nobs - n_for + 1):nobs, ]
weather_july2010 <- weather_test[1:31, ]
observed_july2010 <- data_full$avg_load[(nobs - n_for + 1):(nobs - n_for + 31)]

cat("Training observations:", length(demand_train), "\n")
cat("Validation observations:", 31, "\n")
```

## Test Multiple K Configurations

This section tests various K values to find optimal Fourier harmonics.

```{r}
# Define K configurations to test
K_configs <- list(
  c(1, 4),   # Simple weekly, moderate annual
  c(2, 4),   # Current best
  c(3, 4),   # More weekly detail
  c(1, 6),   # Simple weekly, more annual
  c(2, 6),   # Moderate weekly, more annual
  c(3, 6),   # More weekly, more annual
  c(2, 8),   # Moderate weekly, high annual
  c(3, 8),   # High weekly, high annual
  c(4, 8),   # Very high detail (might overfit)
  c(2, 10),  # Moderate weekly, very high annual
  c(1, 8)    # Simple weekly, high annual
)

# Storage for results
results_list <- list()

# Test each K configuration
cat("\n=== TESTING K CONFIGURATIONS ===\n\n")

for(i in 1:length(K_configs)) {
  K_val <- K_configs[[i]]
  
  cat("Testing K =", K_val, "...\n")
  
  # Fit model
  model <- auto.arima(demand_train,
                      seasonal = FALSE,
                      lambda = 0,
                      xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = K_val),
                                  weather_train))
  
  # Forecast validation period
  forecast_val <- forecast(model,
                          h = 31,
                          xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = K_val, h = 31),
                                      weather_july2010))
  
  # Calculate accuracy
  acc <- accuracy(forecast_val$mean, observed_july2010)
  
  # Store results
  results_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    K_weekly = K_val[1],
    K_annual = K_val[2],
    RMSE = acc[2],
    MAE = acc[3],
    MAPE = acc[5],
    AIC = model$aic,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("  RMSE:", round(acc[2], 2), "| MAPE:", round(acc[5], 2), "%\n\n")
}

# Combine results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df <- results_df %>%
  arrange(RMSE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number())

cat("\n=== FINAL RANKINGS ===\n")
print(results_df)
```

## Display Results Table

```{r}
kbl(results_df,
    caption = "K Value Optimization Results - Ranked by RMSE",
    digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#90EE90")  # Highlight best
```

## Generate Final Forecasts for Top 5 K Values

```{r}
# Get top 5 K configurations
top5_K <- results_df %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  select(K_weekly, K_annual)

cat("\n=== GENERATING KAGGLE SUBMISSIONS FOR TOP 5 ===\n\n")

# Weather for July 2011
july2010_weather <- weather_xreg[(nobs - n_for + 1):(nobs - n_for + 31), ]
july2011_dates <- seq(as.Date("2011-07-01"), as.Date("2011-07-31"), by = "day")

for(i in 1:nrow(top5_K)) {
  K_val <- c(top5_K$K_weekly[i], top5_K$K_annual[i])
  
  cat("Generating submission for K =", K_val, "\n")
  
  # Retrain on full data
  model_final <- auto.arima(demand_msts,
                            seasonal = FALSE,
                            lambda = 0,
                            xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K = K_val),
                                        weather_xreg))
  
  # Forecast July 2011
  forecast_final <- forecast(model_final,
                            h = 31,
                            xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K = K_val, h = 31),
                                        july2010_weather))
  
  # Create submission file
  submission <- data.frame(
    date = july2011_dates,
    load = as.numeric(forecast_final$mean)
  )
  
  # Save with descriptive filename
  filename <- paste0("Submissions/k_optimization/gilman_salzberg_arima_weather_K",
                    K_val[1], "_", K_val[2], ".csv")
  write.csv(submission, file = filename, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("  Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

cat("\n=== COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Generated", nrow(top5_K), "Kaggle submission files\n")
cat("Submit all files to Kaggle and compare scores!\n")
```

cat("\n=== BEST CONFIGURATION ===\n")
cat("K =", best_K, "\n")

## Plot Top 3 Forecasts

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Compare top 3 visually
top3_forecasts <- list()

for(i in 1:3) {
  K_val <- c(results_df$K_weekly[i], results_df$K_annual[i])
  
  model <- auto.arima(demand_train,
                      seasonal = FALSE,
                      lambda = 0,
                      xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = K_val),
                                  weather_train))
  
  forecast_val <- forecast(model,
                          h = 31,
                          xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = K_val, h = 31),
                                      weather_july2010))
  
  top3_forecasts[[i]] <- forecast_val
}

# Create comparison plot
test_load <- data_full$avg_load[(nobs - n_for + 1):nobs]
test_load_clean <- na.interp(test_load, linear = TRUE)
demand_test <- msts(test_load_clean,
                    seasonal.periods = c(7, 365.25),
                    start = c(2010, 182))

autoplot(demand_test) +
  autolayer(top3_forecasts[[1]], series = paste0("K=", results_df$K_weekly[1], ",", results_df$K_annual[1]), PI=FALSE) +
  autolayer(top3_forecasts[[2]], series = paste0("K=", results_df$K_weekly[2], ",", results_df$K_annual[2]), PI=FALSE) +
  autolayer(top3_forecasts[[3]], series = paste0("K=", results_df$K_weekly[3], ",", results_df$K_annual[3]), PI=FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(2010.5, 2010.5 + 31/365.25)) +
  ylab("Average Daily Load (kWh)") +
  xlab("Date") +
  labs(title = "Top 3 K Configurations - July 2010 Validation",
       color = "Model") +
  theme_classic()
```
